'''Hellena Tano''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] living during the [[Eternal Empire conquest]]. By [[3630 BBY]], she was wanted by the [[Eternal Empire]] for murder, slander and inciting treason. Her wanted poster was displayed in the [[Overwatch]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

She shared her surname with [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], a female Togruta [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who was active [[22 BBY/Legends|over 3,600 years later]] and participated in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="TCW">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Hellena Tano appears during '''Chapter 10: Anarchy in Paradise''' of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' on a wanted holo-poster.
